subject: Exec arrival logistics: pre-boarding, ADA rooms, and split transport plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, events.sf@hilton-partners.com, ops@travelops.co
Cc: derek.hughes@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec arrival coordination: pre-boarding, ADA rooms, split transport

Hi team + Hilton/TravelOps,

We need to lock the logistics for next week's Acme executive workshop (arrivals Tues/Wed). Key asks below — please treat as action items with owners: 

1) Hotel room block and ADA rooms
   - Confirm 12 standard + 4 suites under the Redwood block; 2 rooms must be ADA-accessible on ground floor (one has mobility-device requirement).
   - Early check-in for 5 late-night arrivals (arrive ~1–3am) — can we pre-room them where possible?

2) Split transport and shuttle windows
   - We plan 3 shuttle windows on Tuesday: 09:30, 13:00, 18:15. Two execs will arrive outside these windows and require private town cars. Marcus, can you confirm which arrivals need cars?

3) Dietary capture + pre-board sheet
   - Attached is a working preboard list (redwood_exec_preboard_list_20270528.csv) with dietary and ADA notes. Please validate and return with any hotel limitations.

4) Billing and masterbill
   - We will direct-bill incidentals and master bill to Redwood. Sending DocuSign link for direct-bill later today.

Attachments: redwood_exec_preboard_list_20270528.csv, key_schedule_v1.pdf

Hilton / TravelOps: please confirm ADA room locations, early check-in policy for the block, and if you can hold two parking spaces for late-night pickups.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Events & Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0137

From: Hilton Events <events.sf@hilton-partners.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, ops@travelops.co
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec arrival coordination: pre-boarding, ADA rooms, split transport

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the details. Quick confirmations below and a few clarifying Qs: 

- Room block: We have 12 standard rooms + 4 suites tentatively held under "Redwood Inference" (block ID: RW-5231). We can guarantee two ADA rooms on the garden level; one is ADA-roll-in shower, the other is roll-under sink.
- Early check-in: We can pre-room up to three very-late arrivals (1–3am) if you provide passports or IDs at least 48 hours ahead; otherwise we can hold luggage and expedite check-in upon arrival.
- Parking: We will reserve two short-term loading spots near the porte-cochère for late-night pickups.
- Catering/dietary: We can accommodate GF, DF, vegetarian, halal — please flag any severe allergies on the preboard sheet.

Request: Can TravelOps provide exact ETA per flight for the three private car requests? Also attaching the master bill template for your finance team to review.

Attachment: master_bill_template.pdf

Regards,
Maya Singh
Sr. Group Sales Manager — Hilton SF Bay
events.sf@hilton-partners.com
+1 (415) 800-2244

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com

Stephanie — noted and thanks to Hilton for the confirmations.

Updates from my side: 
- Shuttle counts: 09:30 (10 pax), 13:00 (14 pax), 18:15 (8 pax). I updated the attached CSV with those numbers and added a column for "mobility assistance" — seeing 1 confirmed mobility-device.
- Marcus: Derek Hughes (Acme) flagged two arrivals that may be delayed until ~02:00 local. Can you confirm whether we should schedule town cars (preferred) or accept the hotel's pre-rooming hold?

I'll consolidate final list Sunday evening and send to Hilton and TravelOps.

Laura

laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

Confirmed — Derek's two late arrivals are on AA 1928 (ETA 01:45) and UA 374 (ETA 02:20). Please book two town cars for those two and note the mobility-device passenger needs a car with rear entry and extra trunk space for the chair.

I'll ping TravelOps with flight numbers and preferred car vendor.

— Marcus

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com, rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com, events.sf@hilton-partners.com, ops@travelops.co

Subject: Exec arrival logistics — final plan and owners (ACTION REQUIRED)

Thanks team — final plan below. Please mark done in the shared sheet.

- Hilton: hold block RW-5231 and confirm the two ADA rooms on garden level. Pre-room the two late arrivals if IDs provided, otherwise accept town-car strategy. Point of contact: Maya Singh (events.sf@hilton-partners.com).
- TravelOps: book two town cars for AA 1928 & UA 374, cars must support mobility-device (rear entry + trunk space). Please share driver names and local contact by 11:00pm PDT Monday.
- Laura: finalize passenger manifest and send final preboard CSV to Maya by 06/01 12:00pm PDT.
- Rachel: confirm DocuSign for master-bill direct-bill (link below) and route to finance if any missing fields.
- Marcus: escort contact for late pickup; you'll be on-call and have the hotel key schedule.

Links & attachments:
- Preboard (latest): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1a2b3cExecArrivalPlan
- DocuSign master-bill: https://app.docusign.com/secure/prepare?envelopeId=2F3G4H5I
- Ops ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-482

Attachments: redwood_exec_preboard_list_20270528.csv, key_schedule_v1.pdf, master_bill_template.pdf

If Hilton needs anything else (rooming photos, ADA floorplan), let me know — we can escalate to property GM.

Thanks — Stephanie
